en.WelcomeMsg: You are connected to the Crisis Response Line. A responder is here with you. Are you safe right now?
en.GoodbyeMsg: The responder has left the chat. If the situation changes or you are in danger, contact us again or call your local emergency number.
en.EndChatMsg: You ended the chat. If the situation changes or you are in danger, contact us again or call your local emergency number.
en.ClosedOutOfShift: This line is temporarily unavailable. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number now.
en.ClosedHolidays: This line is temporarily unavailable. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number now.
en.UnsupportedMediaErrorMsg: Sorry, the message you just sent is unsupported and could not be delivered.
